# Com Pors

> Com Pors is an independent technology journal delivering daily investigative journalism, software architecture blueprints, semiconductor analysis, and enterprise IT evaluations.

## Docs

- [About Com Pors](https://www.compors.com/about/): Editorial standards, ethics policies, and newsroom mission.
- [Editorial Masthead & Authors](https://www.compors.com/authors/): Information on contributing editors and systems researchers.
- [Newsroom Contact](https://www.compors.com/contact/): Editorial desk inquiries, tips, and corrections.
- [Sitemap](https://www.compors.com/sitemap.xml): Complete indexing of technical publications.

## Categories

- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.compors.com/category/artificial-intelligence/): Neural networks, frontier LLMs, autonomous agents, and generative machine learning.
- [Software Engineering](https://www.compors.com/category/software-engineering/): High-throughput distributed systems, API architecture, and software design patterns.
- [Cloud Computing](https://www.compors.com/category/cloud-computing/): Kubernetes orchestration, serverless microservices, and enterprise cloud infrastructure.
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.compors.com/category/cybersecurity/): Zero trust network architecture, threat intelligence, and defensive tooling.
- [Hardware & Semiconductors](https://www.compors.com/category/hardware-semiconductors/): Microprocessor architectures, AI accelerators, and silicon fabrication nodes.
- [Future Tech](https://www.compors.com/category/future-tech/): Frontier computing, quantum processors, and neuromorphic silicon.
- [Web Development](https://www.compors.com/category/web-development/): Full-stack engineering guides, web standards, and modern frameworks.

## Optional

- [Architecting the Silicon Era](https://www.compors.com/architecting-silicon-era-technology-1980s/): Analysis of 1980s computing architecture and microprocessor design.
- [People Process Technology Framework](https://www.compors.com/scaling-systems-with-people-process-technology/): Organizational engineering and systems scaling principles.
- [Instructional Technology Services](https://www.compors.com/instructional-technology-services-modern-enterprise-it/): Enterprise educational infrastructure and digital learning platforms.
- [Granular Recovery Technology](https://www.compors.com/granular-recovery-technology-in-enterprise-systems/): Disaster recovery architectures and block-level backup design.
- [Technology Solutions Professional Guide](https://www.compors.com/scaling-systems-with-a-technology-solutions-professional/): Cloud systems modernization and enterprise infrastructure consulting.
- [Modern Technology Information Management Systems](https://www.compors.com/modern-technology-information-management-systems/): Enterprise data pipelines and governance frameworks.
- [Engineering Managed Technology Services](https://www.compors.com/engineering-managed-technology-services-infrastructure/): Scalable managed infrastructure and operational reliability.
- [Architecting Business Technology Solutions](https://www.compors.com/architecting-business-technology-solutions/): Enterprise solution blueprints and distributed workloads.
- [Role of an Information Technology Specialist](https://www.compors.com/the-role-of-an-information-technology-specialist/): Systems administration, security, and infrastructure roles.
